drivingQuestion: How can one witness take a two-man stone?

segments.he: אֶלָּא, דְּמַדְלֵי לַהּ בַּהֲדֵי חַבְרֵיהּ, וְשָׁדֵי לַהּ אִיהוּ, כִּי הֵיכִי דְּתֵיתֵי מֵרַזְיָא.
segments.en: «Rather,» both the mishna and the baraita should be explained as follows: The second witness «lifts» the stone «together with the other» witness, «but» then the second witness alone «casts it so that it should fall with force» upon the condemned party’s chest, as two people working together cannot aim their throw with precision.

moves.about: the witness lifts with his fellow but casts it alone, reconciling mishna and baraita

edges.about: the witness lifts with his fellow but casts it alone, reconciling mishna and baraita

positions.claim: both witnesses lift; the second casts it alone for force

unresolved.issue: biurHe empty for every segment of this sugya; roles and actors read from he/steinsaltzHe/en only
